3265cf8e-d7bd-5361-9441-ed47eccd3598.sourceText: Die Uhrenmühle spielt jede Nacht dieselbe Stunde, und danach fehlen im Dorf ein Name und ein Wort für die Zeit.

en.text: Every night the clockmill plays the same hour, and afterwards the village is missing a name and a word for time.

tr.text: Saat değirmeni her gece aynı saati çalıyor ve sonrasında köyde bir isim ile zamanı anlatan bir kelime eksik oluyor.

bb75f35e-c0ec-516e-9fa7-d8dcf11600d0.sourceText: Jedes Mal, wenn die große Glocke läutet, werden ein Name in Waldruh und ein Wort wie „Versprechen“ leiser.

en.text: Every time the great bell rings, a name in Waldruh and a word like “promise” grow quieter.

tr.text: Büyük çan her çaldığında Waldruh'daki bir isim ve „söz“ gibi bir kelime biraz daha sessizleşiyor.

08dae7a0-081b-5af4-89bf-bef97441580f.sourceText: Du hast Hunger. Geh zu Marta ins Café.

en.text: You are hungry. Go to Marta at the café.

9f039503-fd7d-5e98-80ca-af08d20068f6.sourceText: Aber jetzt wartet Otto am Plan.

en.text: But right now Otto is waiting at the timetable.

tr.text: Ama şimdi Otto tarifenin başında bekliyor.

fe480fb0-1428-5fc2-9865-00e8cdb8724a.sourceText: Fritz hat Brot. Geh zu ihm.

en.text: Fritz has bread. Go to him.

b6554d75-ed4b-5a75-95ad-af294f211ce5.sourceText: Marta sagt, du hast die Rechnung noch. Gut so!

en.text: Marta says you still have the receipt. Good!

tr.text: Marta, fişin hâlâ sende olduğunu söylüyor. İyi!

9222ce90-66a2-545a-a512-93e22048f047.sourceText: Marta sagt, Voss hat deine Rechnung. Er hat alles.

en.text: Marta says Voss has your receipt. He has everything.

tr.text: Marta, fişinin Voss’ta olduğunu söylüyor. Her şey onda.

807c1f0c-2ead-5f58-aad6-54c2e4d34949.sourceText: Fritz wartet auf dich. Geh wieder zu ihm.

en.text: Fritz is waiting for you. Go back to him.

tr.text: Fritz seni bekliyor. Yine ona git.

8877cbcd-ecb7-59bd-9903-01a3f905bd56.sourceText: Geh morgen zu Marta. Sie hat ein Telefon.

en.text: Go to Marta tomorrow. She has a telephone.

tr.text: Yarın Marta’ya git. Onun telefonu var.

23041d1b-6e3c-5719-8bcd-a5e786146fb3.sourceText: Otto wartet am Bahnhof. Geh zu ihm.

en.text: Otto is waiting at the station. Go to him.

bc31ce53-dd33-55df-bece-a646a6cf084c.sourceText: Sieh, die Lampe! Beim Messingamt geht sie aus.

en.text: Look, the lamp! By the Brass Office it goes out.

tr.text: Bak, lamba! Pirinç Daire’nin yanında sönüyor.

35c95e24-8fbb-5ba0-a601-a0bd7148c261.sourceText: Lina wartet auf ihr Fahrrad. Geh zur Post.

en.text: Lina is waiting for her bike. Go to the post office.

034dde91-f891-5ebd-a582-30110edfc525.sourceText: Ich suche noch deine Post. Geh zu Fritz.

en.text: I am still looking for your post. Go to Fritz.

3dbbce63-e088-52d0-8033-a160d3d7ceb1.sourceText: Bis Freitag! Lina hat noch Post für dich.

en.text: See you Friday! Lina still has post for you.

tr.text: Cumaya kadar! Lina’da senin için hâlâ posta var.

1c1a6d2b-8242-528b-8b86-7337bd16a811.sourceText: Geh zu ihr auf die Post.

en.text: Go to her at the post office.

9963e452-73ad-512d-8d13-a428616c3d57.sourceText: Fritz wartet auf dich. Geh wieder zu ihm.

en.text: Fritz is waiting for you. Go back to him.

tr.text: Fritz seni bekliyor. Yine ona git.
